messages.content: Help me create a spy instance for an Elasticsearch test framework, given the mock creation settings `mockSettings`, a mock handler `mockHandler`, and an object `testObject` to be spied upon?

function.name: SecureMockMaker_createSpy
function.description: Creates a spy instance for a given object using the provided mock creation settings and handler. This is used within the Elasticsearch test framework. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

settings.description: The settings for creating the mock. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

handler.description: The handler to be used for the mock. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

object.description: The actual object to create a spy for. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

The function expects a JSON object with keys: settings, handler, object. The values are string representations of Java objects. So we need to pass the string representations of mockSettings, mockHandler, testObject. The user didn't specify the actual values, so we can just pass placeholders or the variable names as strings. The function returns any. We need to call it via the tool. So we should produce a tool call with the arguments.
